tk_source: M=accSumCubes;F=modulo(left:i64;right:i64):i64{let div=mut.left/right;let mul=mut.div*right;let rem=mut.left-mul;if(rem<0){if(right<0){rem=rem-right}el{rem=rem+right}};<rem};F=sumCubes(n:i64):i64{if(n<1){<0};let sum=mut.0;let i=mut.1;lp(let i=1;i<n+1;i=i+1){let m=mut.i;let cube=mut.0;lp(let j=0;j<m;j=j+1){cube=cube+m*m};sum=sum+cube};<sum};F=sumCubesModulo(left:i64;right:i64):i64{<sumCubes(modulo(left;right))};F=accumulate(arr:[i64]):i64{let r=mut.0;lp(let i=0;i<arr.len as i64;i=i+1){r=r+sumCubes(arr[i as u64]);};<r};
